source: بازی آموزشی کل دروس سوم ابتدایی.docx — SOCIAL-01 «من به دنیا آمدم» (L11806–11830: quest, Drag → Timeline Snap, cards move on the time rail, album/photo/timeline/clock/memory box, wrong = a newer event before an older one, H1–H3, SOC01_ASSET_01..05, paper_flip/wood_snap/soft_clock_tick, analytics timeline_error/reorder_count/hint_level, mastery = a timeline for a NEW event set, transfer = plant growth); plan 04 row SOC-01; plan 12 §2 row 7 (VS: life timeline in VIL_HOUSE with 5 slots); textbook C307 lesson 1 p. 2 (birth: the nurse inks the footprint, name band, birth certificate) and lesson 2 p. 6 (Amir, 9, grade 3; «خط زمان»: گذشته · حال · آینده).
design_note: The timeline runs LEFT (past) → RIGHT (today) with an empty arrow head for the future, exactly like the textbook timelines (C307 p. 6 and worksheet 1), even though Persian text reads right-to-left. Cards come from the open album (the plant cards from the pot on the sill) and snap into five slots; dropping on an occupied slot swaps. When all five slots are full the brass time key at the left end glows; turning it sends the marker along the rail from birth to today: it stops at the first card that happened BEFORE the card on its left (rule newer_before_older) and the pair wobbles. A (nearly) fully reversed row — at least 9 of the 10 pairs inverted, i.e. read right-to-left — is its own misconception (timeline_reversed). Source props per stage: the encounter cards rise from the album (SOC01_ASSET_01), the practice cards come out of the memory box that opened at the encounter payoff (SOC01_ASSET_04: more of Amir's keepsakes), the transfer cards from the plant pot on the window sill.

story.note: Amir = the textbook's own example child (C307 p. 6: 9 years old, grade 3); his house in the silent village: the album spilled, the mantel clock stopped.

reading.note: tap a card → the Reading Card with the full sentence; the listen button appears after 3 s. vo_status 'ready' = all 20 clips exist (15 cards + 5 hints; round 15: encounter + hints, round 16: practice + transfer). 'partial' would voice only the keys in vo_ready.
reading.tts_rule: light marking (round 13): text_fa + kasra only for an unwritten ezafe, «ـهٔ» after a silent ه, damma on پُر/گُل/نُه (نه = nine vs no); digits are spoken words in tts_fa (۹ → نُه).

misconceptions.description: card: «هر تصویر فقط یک اتفاق جداست و ترتیب زمانی مهم نیست.» — a newer event is put before an older one
the row is built right-to-left (reading direction) — today first, birth last; the arrow of the timeline is ignored

mastery.note: card mastery = a timeline for a NEW event set → the practice (new memories of Amir) without H2/H3 and without Assist gives level 3; the plant transfer on top of it gives 4 (Proficient, plan 06 §9); level 5 needs a transfer in another room (SCI growth, later).

audio.on_wrong: soft_error — the pair wobbles, never punishing
audio.on_solve: the mantel clock starts ticking + the memory box opens + luma_motif_3_note_ascending
